definitions: The larva of a blowfly, especially Cochliomyia hominivorax, that infests the wounds of warm-blooded animals, including humans.
A parasitic fly whose larvae infest the flesh of living animals.
examples: The cattle were treated for screwworm infestation.
Screwworm eradication programs have been successful in some regions.
A single screwworm can cause significant damage to livestock.
